description: MobBlocks is a Fabric mod that replaces normal block drops with a mob encounter. When you break a block, a random mob spawns and you must kill it to receive the items.

releases.notes:
MobBlocks — v1.0.0 Initial Release

Features
  • Mob encounters on every block break — breaking any block removes it and spawns a random glowing mob in its place
  • One block at a time — you cannot break another block until the current mob is killed
  • Death penalty — if you die before killing the mob, the pending mob is removed and the block's drops are lost
  • Mob drop control — configure whether mobs drop their own natural loot in addition to the block's items
  • Block binding — optionally map each block type to a fixed mob, making every world feel unique while staying consistent within the same world
  • Persistent configuration — all settings are saved to config/mobblocks.json and survive server restarts

Commands

Command | Description -- | -- /mobblocks status | Shows the current configuration /mobblocks mobdrops | Toggles natural mob loot (default: off) /mobblocks blockbinding | Toggles deterministic block-to-mob mapping (default: off)

Requirements

  • Minecraft Java Edition
  • Fabric Loader
  • Fabric API
